issues.description: The template and solution differ structurally in the Bitmap24 class constructors: the template header declares only Bitmap24(int,int) while the implementation defines both Bitmap24(int,int) and a default Bitmap24(). In the solution, the header matches the implementation by declaring both constructors. This mismatch can confuse students and can break compilation/linking if they modify or include headers expecting a default constructor (as done in main.cpp).
issues.suggestedFix: In the template repository, add the missing default constructor declaration `Bitmap24();` to example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp (matching the existing definition in Bitmap24.cpp), or remove the default constructor definition from Bitmap24.cpp and update main.cpp to use Bitmap24(width,height) consistently.

issues.description: Macro name controlling inclusion of assembler test main is inconsistent: most files use `%ifndef era` / `-Dera=1`, but tests compile with `-dera=1` (lowercase `d` and different define style). This mismatch can confuse students about the single intended identifier (`era`) and how to enable/disable test mains consistently across build artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Use one consistent macro definition style and identifier everywhere, e.g. change tests/Makefile nasm invocations from `-dera=1` to `-Dera=1` (or update all asm files to check `%ifndef era` and define `-Dera=1` accordingly), so students only track a single macro name and usage.
